propositions: The test kills its pytest-xdist worker on macOS py3.13 due to exceeding the 300s per-test timeout budget set by pytest-timeout with thread method, which calls os._exit(1) on the worker process.

The test's cost is unbounded and load-dependent, measuring 91.6s idle and 504.8s under saturating CPU pressure (1.7x over 300s budget) by iterating 884 renderable units each rendered twice (~1768 pandoc spawns in one test function).

The 14-minute gap between node-down log and crash report is a reporting artifact caused by xdist logging the worker death live while pytest prints the crash report only at session end, and does not indicate kill latency.

Chunk-parametrizing the equivalence test with fixed _EQUIVALENCE_CHUNK=40 bounds per-test cost structurally independent of corpus growth, reducing worst case from 504.8s to 38.05s under saturation while preserving all 884 unit comparisons with real pandoc.
Adding test_the_equivalence_chunks_cover_every_renderable_unit guards against silently dropping units by asserting chunk concatenation equals the full _renderable_units list with total >= 100.
The fix does not raise timeout budget, add retry markers, assert on elapsed time, or modify the renderer itself.
